sensor_id, smoke_concentration, temperature, battery_level, device_status, collection_time, create_time, update_time, remark,
#{sensorId}, #{smokeConcentration}, #{temperature}, #{batteryLevel}, #{deviceStatus}, #{collectionTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{remark},
mapper.select:
select
avg(smoke_concentration) as avgSmoke, avg(temperature) as avgTemp, avg(battery_level) as avgBattery
max(smoke_concentration) as maxSmoke, max(temperature) as maxTemp, max(battery_level) as maxBattery
min(smoke_concentration) as minSmoke, min(temperature) as minTemp, min(battery_level) as minBattery
avg(smoke_concentration) as avgSmoke, avg(temperature) as avgTemp, avg(battery_level) as avgBattery
from sensor_data_log where sensor_id = #{sensorId} and collection_time between #{startTime} and #{endTime}

select id, sensor_id, smoke_concentration, temperature, battery_level, device_status, collection_time, create_time, update_time, remark from sensor_data_log where sensor_id = #{sensorId} order by collection_time desc limit 1
